AtesOut.description: Every ATES file the owner has supplied, as one collection.
AtesOut.title: AtesOut

AvalancheDoc.description: One location's forecast, normalised from either provider.
AvalancheDoc.title: AvalancheDoc

AvalancheView.description: What the app may show right now.
AvalancheView.title: AvalancheView

AvyRef.description: Where to find the avalanche forecast. Canadian zones are looked up by point.
AvyRef.title: AvyRef

BudgetOut.description:
Estimated daily Open-Meteo use. `per_location` and `total` count against the public
daily limit (`budget`): everything without a self-hosted server, only ensembles with
one (`local_forecasts`).
BudgetOut.title: BudgetOut

CatalogAddIn.description: Ski areas to add from the catalog, each resolved and saved by the worker.
CatalogAddIn.title: CatalogAddIn

CloudsOut.description:
The cloud layers above a location hour by hour, from one model's cloud cover at each
pressure level (analysis/clouds.py): an approximation, for the map's 3D clouds.
CloudsOut.title: CloudsOut

CompareDay.description: One location's day at one band (a night goes with its evening's date).
CompareDay.title: CompareDay

CompareOut.description: Every location's days at each band, for ranking them on Compare's Add list.
CompareOut.title: CompareOut

ConcernOut.description:
The experimental terrain concern index's settings (config `terrain:`), for every
visitor unless HAZARD_INDEX is off. The browser works the index out from these.
ConcernOut.title: ConcernOut

CornDay.description:
A spring corn window: after a refreeze, when sunny aspects soften (an estimate
from the sun on 35° slopes and the temperature at mid).
CornDay.title: CornDay

DangerChip.description: The highest avalanche rating for a day, when the forecast is current.
DangerChip.title: DangerChip

DayOut.description: One day for Plan a day and the ski-day rating. Snow and temperatures at mid.
DayOut.title: DayOut

EnsembleSystemOut.description: Where one ensemble system's members come from (milestone 1b).
EnsembleSystemOut.title: EnsembleSystemOut

Flag.description: Something worth a look (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). The browser words it in your units.
Flag.title: Flag

LocalServerOut.description: The self-hosted Open-Meteo server (OPEN_METEO_URL), from today's requests.
LocalServerOut.title: LocalServerOut

MapCloudsLocation.description:
A location's cloud layers hour by hour, placed at its middle, with the heights its
bands span (so the map can say whether the summit is above the cloud).
MapCloudsLocation.title: MapCloudsLocation

MapCloudsOut.description: Each location's cloud layers for the map's 3D clouds: an approximation.
MapCloudsOut.title: MapCloudsOut

MapWindLocation.description: A location's loading roses, placed at its summit (where the wind is taken).
MapWindLocation.title: MapWindLocation

MapWindOut.description: Wind and new snow per location for the map's wind-effect layer.
MapWindOut.title: MapWindOut

MetaOut.description: About this server: version, and numbers the app shows instead of hard-coding them.
MetaOut.title: MetaOut

ModelRunOut.description: One model's latest run, as the model watcher last read it (milestone 4).
ModelRunOut.title: ModelRunOut

NearbyOut.description:
What was measured and reported around a location (the Observed tab): the
closest snow stations and recent field reports (Avalanche Canada's Mountain
Information Network and NWAC's observations), read from the files the map's layers
use.
NearbyOut.title: NearbyOut

ObsOut.description: Recent field reports in the map's box.
ObsOut.title: ObsOut

ObsSign.description: A sign of instability an observer reported (NWAC's form).
ObsSign.title: ObsSign

OutlookDay.description:
One calendar day of avalanche weather: what the forecast would do to the
snowpack, and the day's touring weather. Not a danger rating: it knows nothing of
the snowpack itself. Snow, wind, sky and the thaw are the summit's; rain, the
freezing level and warming are mid's.
OutlookDay.title: OutlookDay

OutlookLevels.description:
How hard each weather factor pushes on the snowpack: 0 nothing, 1 some,
2 strong, 3 very strong (thresholds in config `backcountry:`).
OutlookLevels.title: OutlookLevels

OutlookSteps.description:
The values where each outlook factor becomes some, strong and very strong
(config `backcountry:`), so the page can say what its levels mean.
OutlookSteps.title: OutlookSteps

OverviewRow.description: One location on the Overview and Calendar pages (mid band).
OverviewRow.title: OverviewRow

PlanOut.description: Plan a day: every location on one date.
PlanOut.title: PlanOut

PointOut.description: What the map's weather says at a point (GET /api/map/point).
PointOut.title: PointOut

PointRate.description: One frame of the precipitation timeline at the point.
PointRate.title: PointRate

Reason.description: Why a day got its rating. The browser words it in the viewer's units.
Reason.title: Reason

RidgeOut.description: Free-air wind at summit height, aligned with each band's `hourly.t`.
RidgeOut.title: RidgeOut

RoseOut.description: Where wind would drift new snow: snowfall × ridge wind per sector (N first, clockwise).
RoseOut.title: RoseOut

SatComposite.description: The newest clear view of the area, stitched from passes (see `stitch`).
SatComposite.title: SatComposite

SatLayer.description: One pass in a stitched view.
SatLayer.title: SatLayer

SatOut.description:
The map's recent satellite imagery: daily VIIRS everywhere, and per location a
stitched newest-clear view and the newest whole clear scenes.
SatOut.title: SatOut

SatPart.description: Where one pass supplies a stitched view, for the map's outlines and dates.
SatPart.title: SatPart

SatScene.description: One pass that covers the whole area and sees most of it: a coherent picture.
SatScene.title: SatScene

ShadowOut.description:
A system's shadow-mode comparisons over the last 7 days: the server's answers
against the public API's for the same requests.
ShadowOut.title: ShadowOut

SkyDay.description: Daytime sky at the summit: mean cloud per layer (%) and the lowest visibility.
SkyDay.title: SkyDay

SnowpackOut.description:
The models' snow on the ground at mid (milestone 3): for places with no station
(every spot), and as a line beside a station's depth.
SnowpackOut.title: SnowpackOut

SpotInfo.description:
A forecast for a point tapped on the map (a spot), made on request
(snowwatch/spots.py). Its three bands share the point and differ in elevation.
SpotInfo.title: SpotInfo

SpotNearest.description: The saved location nearest a spot.
SpotNearest.title: SpotNearest

SpotPeak.description:
The named peak a spot is named after: on it (`bearing` None, within 0.5 km), or
`km` away with the spot to its `bearing` (N, NE …). The app words the distance.
SpotPeak.title: SpotPeak

StatusOut.description: The Status page: per-source health, runs, usage and data age.
StatusOut.title: StatusOut

TreelineRule.description: Where the treeline band is: the first rule whose conditions all match wins.
TreelineRule.title: TreelineRule

TreelineSpot.description: The owner's treeline numbers near one location.
TreelineSpot.title: TreelineSpot

WarmingOut.description: The biggest 24 h warming in the next 72 h, and rain falling on snow.
WarmingOut.title: WarmingOut

WaterRow.description: A source's precipitation forecasts against the station's gauge.
WaterRow.title: WaterRow

ZonesOut.description: Every forecast zone in the map's box, as published, with expiry applied now.
ZonesOut.title: ZonesOut

description: Every response shape, exported as one JSON Schema for the TypeScript types.
title: ApiTypes
